cutoff_policy: Public official catalog observed by cutoff or authentic Crossref publication-date interval ending on or before cutoff; no S2 preprint date, created date, or missing-date imputation.

topics.name: 四维动态场景重建
topics.query: ((dynamic | deformable | nonrigid | "non-rigid" | "time-varying" | "time varying" | "space-time" | "spatio-temporal" | "4D") + ("neural radiance field" | "Gaussian splatting" | "3D reconstruction" | "scene reconstruction" | "view synthesis" | "surface reconstruction" | "scene representation")) | "non-rigid fusion" | "nonrigid fusion" | "topologically varying"

topics.name: 面向交互的世界模型
topics.query: (("world model" | "world models" | "world simulator" | "latent dynamics" | "action-conditioned prediction" | "action conditioned prediction") + (learning | learned | neural | generative | control | planning | reinforcement | robot))

topics.name: 具身操作中的动作学习
topics.query: ((robot | robotic | visuomotor | "vision-language-action") + (manipulation | grasping | dexterous)) + (learning | learned | policy | imitation | diffusion | transformer | predictive)
